newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks track bonds to come off lows.
newsitem.headline: French stocks track bonds to come off lows.

text.p: French stocks tracked an improvement in bond prices to come off their lows on Tuesday afternoon.

The markets' improvement followed a report from the U.S. Labor Department that U.S. workers' compensation rose 0.6 percent in the third quarter after a 0.8 percent gain in the previous quarter, reflecting slower growth in pay and benefits.
French stocks and bonds were under pressure from a weaker U.S. dollar and concerns that German interest rates may rise.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 1.43 percent at 2,119.60 points, off a low of 2,116.79 at 1245 GMT.
The CAC-40 October futures contract was down 30.5 points at 2,118.
* Pernod up 1.5 percent on reports a parliamentary group challenging planned 17.1 percent increase in spirits tax.
* Lagardere extends loss after 6.9 percent drop on Monday but most analyst say Thomson deal likely to go through despite political opposition and public outcry.
* Renault down two percent. Share weak since last week's report raising doubts about its collaboration with MAN.
* Casino higher on renewed merger speculation.
